title: Both branches of an if-else run in turn
statement: In an if-else statement the if branch runs when the condition is true and then the else branch runs afterwards as well, because it comes next in the code.

evidence_patterns.item_shape: trace an if-else where the condition is true
evidence_patterns.signature: reports the effects of both branches

discriminators.vs_slip: Consistent across items and the learner explains 'it does this one and then that one'. A slip is a single wrong branch.

vs.prog.control.if-is-loop: If-loopers repeat one branch; sequence believers run both once.

conflicts_with.label: An if statement evaluates its condition once and runs at most one branch

resolved_by.label: An if statement evaluates its condition once and runs at most one branch
Statements run one at a time in order
